title: Pets with lives of their own
items: Disk winds lift off the disk, stronger the more it eats; light echoes ripple out after a flare
Fears and hobbies, jealousy, a pecking order, herds of friends, grooming
Shake it upside down and things fall out of its stomach
Ctrl + drag draws a path for it to follow, eating what the path runs into
Sound that follows where the holes are, up and down as well as left and right; dreams have their own sound
Portraits and share cards show each black hole exactly as it looks
About page, local crash reports, and a plugins folder for your own looks and foods
A few new secrets

title: Getting to know it
items: A welcome tour, undo for meals (Ctrl+Alt+Z) and a journal for each black hole
It eats pictures, 3D models (as wireframes) and zip files (which burst open)
Moods change what it will eat; favourite foods; rivalries
A self-test that checks every part and explains what's wrong

title: A real app
items: An installer with Start menu and desktop shortcuts
Settings in tabs, with search, profiles, per-monitor rules, backup and accessibility options
Self-shadowing disks, colour grades, Doppler colour, frame dragging, tides that scale with mass
Faster: the outer lens is worked out directly, effects compile only when used, smarter screen capture
Eddington limit, sulking, yawns, hiccups, dreams, rare traits, breeding, meal stealing, a daily gallery
It eats text, links and browser tabs; food quality; a stomach view
Sonification sound theme, a watchdog that brings everything back after a crash

title: Unlockable looks
items: Jets, debris rings, photon sphere glow, Hawking glow, a companion star, gravitational wave ripples
Spiral, clumpy, banded, warped and magnetised disks; dust trails, starfields, snow and embers
Glitch, white hole, wormhole and inverted black holes
Previews in Settings, effects that combine, and looks for each black hole

title: Social
items: Share codes and share cards, babies, friendships, achievements, a trophy shelf, a family tree
Petting, traits picked at birth, dancing to music on the PC, quiet while you type, parking for fullscreen apps

title: A pet
items: Names, moods, hunger, age and mass kept between launches; spin builds up as it eats
Lens-only rendering and automatic resolution

title: Feeding
items: It eats windows, desktop icons and files, and spits them back out
Binary inspirals with a real chirp, tidal disruptions, mergers with recoil, easter eggs

title: The first black hole
items: A ray-traced, spinning black hole that bends your real desktop, on every monitor
Drag, throw, scroll to change its mass; it evaporates when you close it
